 McCourty channeled his inner Marshawn Lynch 
 The NBC Sports Football Night In America analyst stopped by the show  to share his experience about how a strong defensive line makes everyone’s job a little easier on that side of the ball. He also shares a story about how he once wore his old uniform to his son’s football practice and got to show off his professional talent. That story also leads McCourty to rank some of the toughest players to tackle during his playing days.
